speak.title: Role-play: lights on or lights off?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You share a flat. Your flatmate leaves a bright lamp on all night and you can't sleep. Ask for a change. Listen to the reason before you decide what to agree.

b.text: You like a small light on because you get up in the night and want to feel safe. Explain why total darkness worries you and suggest a fair compromise.

phrases: I've been having trouble sleeping lately.
Would you mind turning the lamp off at night?
I'd feel safer with a small light on.
How about a dim nightlight instead?
That's a fair point, but I'm still tired.
Let's try it for a week and see.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class what you agreed and whether it's a fair deal.
